ValidationRule.description: An Event with a discount greater than 10% of the calculated Standard Price must be approved before moving to Proposal Sent.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( TEXT(Status__c) = "Proposal Sent", TEXT(Status__c) = "Confirmed", TEXT(Status__c) = "In Planning", TEXT(Status__c) = "Executing", TEXT(Status__c) = "Completed" ), Discount_Percentage__c > 0.10, NOT(Manager_Approved__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Discounts greater than 10% of the Standard Price require Manager Approval before moving to Proposal Sent status.
